## Review checklist

- [ ] Outputs reflect an actual run, or sample/synthetic outputs are explicitly labeled.
- [ ] Data coverage, target definitions, and applicable time ordering are checked.
- [ ] Raw datasets, local credentials, and trained model binaries are excluded.
- [ ] A teammate reviewed the change.
